text:
Sofia: Hey team, day 1! I'm on an M2 Mac and trying to build the inference runtime from source. Followed the macOS notes but the build fails at link time expecting CUDA. Any recommended mac build flags or a fast way to run tests against a GPU box?

Sofia: error snippet:
```bash
-- Found CUDA: /usr/local/cuda (found version "12.1")
[ 45%] Linking CXX executable llm_server
ld: library not found for -lcuda
Undefined symbols for architecture arm64: "_cuInit", referenced from: _init_cuda in cuda_helper.cpp.o
```

Mika: welcome! :tada: Mac laptops won't have CUDA; the macOS CUDA path is a leftover if you ran cmake with defaults. You can force a CPU-only build: `cmake -DUSE_CUDA=OFF -B build && cmake --build build -j8`. We also have a helper image `redwood/dev:mac-cpu` used by Mac folks for local dev.

Natanael: +1. Also check you didn't install an NVIDIA toolkit via homebrew by accident. For CI parity, add `-DUSE_CUDA=OFF -DUSE_ROCM=OFF` on arm64. Some modules (third_party plugins) try to link CUDA unconditionally; if you see that, edit CMakeLists or set `BUILD_TELEMETRY=OFF` temporarily.

Rosie: if you want to run with a real GPU for integration tests, ssh to `gpu-dev1.redwood.internal` (we keep a few dev GPUs for onboarding). There's a small onboarding flow: `ssh -A $USER@gpu-dev1` then run `./scripts/bootstrap_dev.sh && make -j16`. Ping infra if you need access (they need to add your SSH key).

Sofia: tried `-DUSE_CUDA=OFF`, build progresses further but hits a symbol issue: `undefined reference to std::__cxx11::basic_string` during link. Is that an ABI mismatch?

Natanael: yep that's libstdc++ vs libc++ on macOS. Our mac builds target libc++ (Clang). Ensure `CXX=clang++` and `export MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=12.0` before configuring. Also remove any host-installed gcc toolchain from PATH that might force libstdc++ linking. Clean build dir and retry.

Sofia: switching to clang++ fixed the std::string link errors. CPU binary builds and unit tests run ok. I'll request GPU access to run the full test suite.

Mika: great. Can you add a short note to the onboarding doc about mac M1/M2 tips (USE_CUDA=OFF, clang, cpu image)? We still get new hires tripping on that.

infra-bot: INFRA-513 created: "Add mac M1/M2 CPU build section + gpu-dev access onboarding" assigned to infra.

Sofia: will do — thanks everyone for the quick help! Tagging @Mika @Natanael if I hit infra access issues. :thumbsup:
